notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
